name: NFL
summary:
The NFL’s site is nfl.com. The shield in the tab is the league icon, not a club mark, and the file below is the one that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against nfl.com. HTML came from https://www.nfl.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://static.www.nfl.com/league/run3dfyjniqxah4ehxfu.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. nfl.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: png-2000x2000-01.png at 2000×2000 (png, 49024 bytes) from https://static.www.nfl.com/league/run3dfyjniqxah4ehxfu.
